# SaveAnswer

> SaveAnswer is a 100% free, 100% local-first Chrome and Microsoft Edge browser extension that saves AI answers from 8 AI chat platforms into a local knowledge workspace, syncs clean Markdown + `INDEX.md` to Obsidian, and works as zero-backend local MCP memory for Cursor and Claude Code. Zero cloud servers, zero tracking, no account required.

## Install & Official Links

- [Official Landing Page](https://charmlynn.github.io/saveanswer/): Overview, 38s walkthrough demo, feature comparison, and FAQ
- [Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/saveanswer-save-ai-answer/iminapemlncanmmaadedieifgkaeoljm): Official Chrome extension listing
- [Microsoft Edge Add-ons](https://microsoftedge.microsoft.com/addons/detail/saveanswer-save-ai-answ/akmhodipofnnogbilbjkmphhikkdjehk): Official Edge extension listing (direct access without VPN in mainland China)
- [Feedback & Support](https://charmlynn.github.io/saveanswer/feedback.html): Submit bug reports, platform requests, or user feedback

## Supported AI Platforms (8)

- **ChatGPT** (`chatgpt.com`, `chat.openai.com`)
- **Claude** (`claude.ai`)
- **DeepSeek** (`chat.deepseek.com`)
- **Gemini** (`gemini.google.com`)
- **Qwen / 通义千问** (`tongyi.aliyun.com`, `chat.qwen.ai`, `qianwen.com`)
- **Grok** (`grok.com`, `x.com/i/grok`)
- **Doubao / 豆包** (`doubao.com`)
- **Kimi** (`kimi.com`, `www.kimi.com`)

## Core Capabilities

- **1-Click Capture & Shortcuts**: Native `Save` button on every AI answer, `Alt+S` to quick-save the latest answer, `Alt+Click` for silent auto-tagged saving, and Highlight-to-Save for partial excerpts.
- **Instant Recall Everywhere**: Press `Alt+K` inside any AI chat input box to search and insert saved notes in place; type `sa <query>` in the browser address bar (Omnibox) to search your vault from any tab.
- **3-Column Desktop Workspace (`Alt+W`)**: Browse, tag, full-text search, batch-merge answers into Table-of-Contents reports, and jump back to the original conversation source with highlight anchoring.
- **Cross-Model Context Relay**: `Copy as Prompt` packages saved Q&A with structured context so you can hand off work seamlessly between ChatGPT, Claude, DeepSeek, and other models.
- **Reasoning & Code Preservation**: Preserves syntax-highlighted code blocks, LaTeX math, tables, and folds `<think>` reasoning chains cleanly.
- **Obsidian & Agent MCP Memory**: Syncs clean Markdown with YAML frontmatter and an auto-maintained `INDEX.md` directly to a local Obsidian vault folder—ready to mount via `@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem` in Cursor or Claude Code.
- **Export & Share**: Export single or merged answers as Markdown, Word (`.docx`), PDF, HTML, or offline 4-theme Share Cards; full JSON backup export/import with deduplication.
- **Privacy Guarantee**: All data stays in local browser IndexedDB / chosen local directory. Zero cloud storage, zero analytics on user conversations, no sign-up.
